# Phase manifest

The complete list of files and folders created in each phase. At the start of a phase we read its section here, scaffold the stubs, commit them, and only then start filling files in one at a time.

```bash
python scripts/repo_manifest.py phase N      # read
python scripts/repo_manifest.py scaffold N   # create stubs
```
